code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The non-background color forming the right and bottom border is the alternate color.
    right = next(c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != bg and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h) if any(v != bg for v in grid[r])))
    border = grid[0][right]
    bottom = next(r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == border for c in range(right)))
    ph = bottom
    # A blank interior row before the bottom border requests checkerboard vertical tiling.
    while ph and all(grid[ph-1][c] == bg for c in range(right)):
        ph -= 1
    alternate = ph < bottom
    pattern = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(right)] for r in range(ph)]
    out = []
    for r in range(h):
        block_r = r // ph
        row = []
        for c in range(w):
            block_c = c // right
            use_border = (block_c + (block_r if alternate else 0)) % 2 == 1
            v = pattern[r % ph][c % right]
            row.append(bg if v == bg else (border if use_border else v))
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
